content.title: Medline Stock Soars 41% After Biggest IPO Since 2021
content.summary: Medline  which calls itself the largest medical-surgical products provider, sells hundreds of thousands of different medical supplies to hospitals and other health providers.  Medline is majority owned by a private-equity partnership made up of funds managed by Blackstone,  Carlyle  and Hellman & Friedman, which bought the company from its founding family in a major leveraged buyout deal in 2021.  Ahead of the IPO, Medline said in a filing that it has received indications of interest in purchasing up to $2.4 billion worth of its shares from funds or accounts managed by Durable Capital Partners, Janus Henderson Investors, Viking Global Investors, and Singapore’s sovereign-wealth fund, among others.
